message.reasoning:
We need to fix compilation errors.

The errors:

- Missing Mockito imports. Possibly we don't need Mockito for this test. The test uses @Mock annotation but not used. We can remove Mockito dependencies. Simplify: remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) and @Mock logger field. Instead, we can just not use them. The test class defines its own StubLogger objects; the @Mock logger field is not used. So delete those lines.

- StubLogger extends MarkerIgnoringBase (from slf4j). The abstract Logger interface has many methods, including error(String) without varargs? In newer SLF4J, Logger has methods: error(String msg); error(String format, Object arg); error(String format, Object arg1, Object arg2); error(String format, Object... arguments); etc. The error says StubLogger does not override abstract method error(String) in Logger. MarkerIgnoringBase implements Logger, but maybe some versions have error(String) abstract. The class overrides error(String format, Object... arguments) and error(String msg, Throwable t) and error(String format, Object arg1) and error(String format, Object arg1, Object arg2) but not error(String). Need to implement error(String msg). Provide empty implementation.

Add:

@Override
public void error(String msg) {
    // no-op
}

Also need to implement other methods maybe: trace, debug, info, warn already. Also need to implement isTraceEnabled etc? MarkerIgnoringBase already implements many methods with default false. So fine.

- Also need to import Logger? Already imported org.slf4j.Logger; that's fine.

- Remove Mockito imports.

- Also need to adjust test method signatures: debug_normalLogging currently expects Logger logger param, but we will be passing StubLogger instances which are Logger. That's fine.

- However the @ParameterizedTest method signature includes Logger logger param, but JUnit will try to inject arguments from MethodSource. The MethodSource returns Stream<Arguments> where each argument is a StubLogger (which implements Logger). That's okay.

- The test class currently has a field annotated @Mock Logger logger; but we will remove it.

- Also need to import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith still used? We'll remove the annotation.

- Remove import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension; import org.mockito.*; Not needed.

- Ensure code compiles with JUnit 5.

- Also need to import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.* already static import.

- Ensure that StubLogger extends MarkerIgnoringBase and implements Logger methods.

- Possibly need to import org.slf4j.Marker? Not needed.

- Also need to add import for org.slf4j.helpers.MarkerIgnoringBase already there.

- The test uses BaseJsonValidator.debug which is protected static void debug(Logger, JsonNode, JsonNode, String). Since it's protected, we cannot call directly from test outside same package? The test class is in same package com.networknt.schema, so protected static method is accessible. Good.

- Ensure BaseJsonValidator.debug exists with that signature. The dependent info says method is protected static void debug(Logger, JsonNode, JsonNode, String). So fine.

- Remove unused imports: maybe java.util.stream.Stream already used.

- Ensure there are no other errors.

Let's rewrite the test class accordingly.
